situation: Cross-cluster cache sharing caches over a WAN in a K8s+K3s estate.
decision: Use central object storage across clusters; do NOT try to share live KV caches over a WAN. Route edge misses to the central cluster.
reasoning_physics: KV caches are latency-native — shipping them over a WAN costs more round-trips than the cache saves, and it violates the engine-specific-artifact rule. Object store is the durable cross-cluster carrier; live caches stay local, misses get routed centrally.
